prompt: Name a letter of the Greek alphabet.

answers.name: Alpha
answers.fact: First letter, and the source of the word alphabet - alpha plus beta.

answers.name: Beta
answers.fact: Second letter. Gave its name to software that is not finished yet.

answers.name: Omega
answers.fact: The last letter, which is why the end of anything is the omega.

answers.name: Delta
answers.fact: Its triangular capital gave river deltas their name.

answers.name: Gamma
answers.fact: Lends its name to the most energetic light in the spectrum.

answers.name: Pi
answers.fact: Chosen for the circle constant in 1706, from the Greek for perimeter.

answers.name: Sigma
answers.fact: The capital means sum in mathematics; the lowercase means standard deviation.

answers.name: Theta
answers.fact: Once marked a death sentence on Athenian ballots, for thanatos.

answers.name: Lambda
answers.fact: The Spartan shield emblem, for Lacedaemon.

answers.name: Epsilon
answers.fact: Means simply e - the short e, as opposed to eta.

answers.name: Omicron
answers.fact: Little o. Known to most people only since 2021.

answers.name: Phi
answers.fact: Used for the golden ratio, roughly 1.618.

answers.name: Zeta
answers.fact: Sixth letter, and the name of a famous unsolved problem in mathematics.

answers.name: Xi
answers.fact: Fourteenth letter, and among the hardest to pronounce in English.

answers.name: Upsilon
answers.fact: The ancestor of both U and Y in the Latin alphabet.

extras.name: Eta
extras.fact: Seventh letter, and the shape the capital lent to the Latin H.

extras.name: Iota
extras.fact: Ninth letter, and the smallest - hence not one iota.

extras.name: Kappa
extras.fact: Tenth letter, and also a sarcasm emote on Twitch, based on a photo of a former site employee.

extras.name: Mu
extras.fact: Twelfth letter, and the prefix micro-.

extras.name: Nu
extras.fact: Thirteenth letter, and the symbol physicists use for frequency in E = hν.

extras.name: Rho
extras.fact: Seventeenth letter, used for density in physics.

extras.name: Tau
extras.fact: Nineteenth letter, and a rival to pi among mathematicians.

extras.name: Chi
extras.fact: Twenty-second letter, the X in Xmas.

extras.name: Psi
extras.fact: Twenty-third letter, and the symbol for psychology.
